pages.text: Place up to four items into the $(item)Astral Forge$() one at a time; take them back with an empty hand. Feed it starlight of the right hue – a beam, or a $(item)Starlight Reservoir$() touching it – and it forges on its own.$(br2)$(l)Sunsteel$() wants Sol, $(l)Moonsilver$() Luna, $(l)Starmetal$() Stella light.
